platform: macOS 26.6.2 arm64; native CPU editable installation
endpoint: OpenAI-compatible HTTP/1.1 streaming chat SSE on loopback

request_contract.dataset: custom JSONL, no shuffle or oversampling, no chat template
request_contract.content_shape: user message with one typed text-content entry

first_event_rule: TTFT is the first nonempty choices event, including role-only frames

end_event_rule.observed_success: no explicit server error and at least one nonempty choices event, with no caught exception
end_event_rule.reported_latency: start to last choices event; later usage/DONE/EOF processing is excluded

precedence: whole reconstructed text through local tokenizer
token_sources.peak_output_tokens_per_s: choices-event timestamp buckets reconstructed from start_times, TTFT and ITL; not usage-weighted model token throughput

partial_output_policy.declared_oracle: explicit SSE error is failed regardless of preceding role or content
partial_output_policy.observed_role_then_error: failure with exact server reason, empty text and zero completed-output tokens
partial_output_policy.observed_text_then_error: failure with exact server reason, preserved Hello world text and zero completed-output tokens
partial_output_policy.local_partial_count: two per text request, ten total; audit count excluded from native completed-output statistics

aggregation_population.token_totals: successful native outputs under declared source precedence

measurement_windows.aggregate_duration: native benchmark duration around five sequential measured requests
measurement_windows.throughput_denominator: native duration, reconciled against native totals
measurement_windows.client_event_window: TTFT plus ITL reconciles with native latency
measurement_windows.server_clock: fixture emission and clean termination only

supported_claims: actual pristine captured PR Python CLI reports all fifteen explicit-error requests as failures with exact reasons
all fifteen normal controls pass and retain their usage counts
failed partial text is retained while ten local partial tokens are excluded from completed-output totals
one/split usage totals remain 15 with peak choices-event counters 10 versus 20
unsupported_claims: merged or rebased current main behavior
production prevalence, model speed or measured model token throughput
causal one-patch CLI comparison against the older baseline
EOF/abort or late-error conformance through this six-case CLI corpus
